title: India Crime Data: NCRB Raw Documents
subtitle: Original NCRB reports and tables, incl. removed ones, with source links
userSpecifiedSources: National Crime Records Bureau (ncrb.gov.in), Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India: Crime in India, Accidental Deaths & Suicides in India, Prison Statistics and additional tables, read from the live site and from the Internet Archive Wayback Machine (web.archive.org), including files since removed. Also Bureau of Police Research & Development, National Human Rights Commission, National Commission for Women, National Commission for Protection of Child Rights, Ministry of Road Transport & Highways, Narcotics Control Bureau and Ministry of Home Affairs documents. News: public RSS feeds of The Hindu, The Times of India, Hindustan Times, NDTV, News18, India Today, Deccan Chronicle, Scroll and other Indian outlets. Place-to-state lookup: GeoNames (geonames.org, CC BY 4.0). Collection code and the full list of upstreams: https://github.com/chandranshB/CrimeBase (SOURCES.md).
description:
# India crime data: the original documents

The unmodified PDF, spreadsheet and Word files behind the cleaned **crimebase** dataset: India's National Crime Records Bureau (*Crime in India*, *Accidental Deaths & Suicides*, *Prison Statistics* and more) and related government bodies, recovered from the live sites and the Internet Archive, **including files that have since been removed**.

## How to use
* `documents.csv` is the catalogue: one row per file with its title, year, size, publisher, original URL, Internet Archive permalink and whether tables were extracted from it. Start there.
* `manifest.csv` is the full ledger: every URL each file was seen at, with SHA-256, Wayback capture time and fetch date.
* Files are content-addressed and live in folders `raw-0` ... `raw-f` (the first character of the file name): `raw-3/3a9f...c1.pdf`. Kaggle unpacks the `raw-*.zip` bundles it is given into those folders.
* The same files are also published as a GitHub release (https://github.com/chandranshB/CrimeBase/releases/tag/raw-archive) for bulk download.
* The tables extracted from these documents are in the companion dataset **crimebase** (`file` there = file name here).

## Provenance and etiquette
Only public government documents are collected, politely (robots.txt honoured, rate-limited, identified). The same bytes under several URLs are stored once and every URL is recorded. Refreshed daily.

Open-source pipeline (AGPL-3.0): https://github.com/chandranshB/CrimeBase. Maintained by Chandransh.

resources.description: Catalogue of every file: title, year, size, publisher, original URL, Internet Archive permalink, parse status.

fields.name: file
fields.description: Document id (first 16 hex characters of its SHA-256 + extension). Same bytes under several URLs share one id.

fields.name: raw_path
fields.description: Where the original file is in the crimebase-raw dataset (raw-<first character>/<file>).

fields.name: ext
fields.description: File type: pdf, xls, xlsx, csv, zip, doc, docx.

fields.name: bytes
fields.description: File size in bytes.

fields.name: publisher
fields.description: Organisation that published the document.

fields.name: title_hint
fields.description: Readable guess at the title, from the file name in the URL.

fields.name: year_hint
fields.description: Year named in the URL, when exactly one is; empty otherwise.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: First URL the file was seen at.

fields.name: wayback_url
fields.description: Internet Archive permalink of the newest capture of these bytes; empty if only seen on a live site.

fields.name: first_capture
fields.description: Date (YYYYMMDD) of the earliest Wayback capture.

fields.name: last_capture
fields.description: Date (YYYYMMDD) of the latest Wayback capture.

fields.name: n_urls
fields.description: Number of distinct URLs that served these bytes.

fields.name: status
fields.description: facts = figures in facts.parquet (an Excel table, or a PDF table whose columns add up); facts_low_confidence = a PDF whose figures could not be checked (facts_pdf_lowconf.parquet); no_tables_found = readable but no NCRB-style table; not_parsed = a type the parser does not read yet.

fields.name: n_facts
fields.description: Number of numbers extracted from the file.

resources.description: Provenance ledger: every URL each file was seen at, with SHA-256, Wayback capture time, publisher and fetch date.

fields.name: url
fields.description: URL the file was fetched from.

fields.name: file
fields.description: Document id; the file is raw-<first character>/<file> in this dataset.

fields.name: sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes.

fields.name: wayback_timestamp
fields.description: 14-digit Internet Archive capture time; empty if fetched from a live site.

fields.name: digest
fields.description: Internet Archive content digest of the capture.

fields.name: publisher
fields.description: Organisation that published the document.

fields.name: retrieved
fields.description: Date fetched from a live site (empty for Wayback captures).

resources.description: Pipeline working state of the live-site crawler (ETag / Last-Modified per URL). Not for analysis.
Original documents whose file names start with this character; Kaggle unpacks them into the folder of the same name.
